message:
Sunday double feature: two Thai schoolboys in a strict small town in the 90s whose secret first love gets dangerous, then two college freshmen who fall hard for each other after a football game until an old family secret gets in the way.
🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xWcI7ptb2ZY
🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WJyADMPVSUQ
Both full movies, free to watch (the first has English subtitles). Have a lovely Sunday night.
